name: Advanced Message Subscription
description: Lets users subscribe to Message-module notifications through a configurable subscription entity type, a subscription plugin type, event dispatch and a queue worker that creates messages.

suggests.message_notify: Enables actually sending notifications for created messages when a subscription type has 'notify' enabled.

project_description: Advanced Message Subscription builds a subscription framework on top of the Message module. It defines a content entity type (advanced_message_subscription) whose bundles are configurable subscription types (adv_message_subscription_type), each bound to an AdvancedMessageSubscription plugin (the ships-with 'entity' plugin subscribes users to a referenced content entity). Entity insert/update/delete hooks dispatch an AdvancedMessageSubscriptionEvent; a SubscriptionProcessor finds matching subscriptions and enqueues items on the advanced_message_subscription_message queue, whose worker creates a Message entity per subscription and, when the subscription type is set to notify and message_notify is installed, sends the notification. A LinkGenerator renders per-entity subscribe/manage links (surfaced as an extra field via entity_view). Subscriptions are owned content entities: create requires the 'manage own advanced_message_subscriptions' permission and view/edit/delete additionally require ownership; type administration requires 'administer advanced_message_subscription types'. Extension points include the plugin type, four hooks (event process, query alter, message create, message post-create) and a notify-cancel hook.
